mission_01: One-hot encoding is the most common technique for converting categorical variables into a format that machine learning algorithms can process. It creates binary columns for each category value, where a 1 indicates presence and 0 indicates absence. This avoids the false ordinal relationship that would be introduced by simply assigning numbers to categories. In this mission, you will use pandas get_dummies() to one-hot encode color and size columns, learning how to handle multiple categorical features and combine them with numeric features.
